description: This repository is three files and a workflow, which is exactly the kind of thing that rots. The job it replaces died partly because its image was unpinned and nothing watched it, so everything here is pinned and Renovate is what keeps the pins current. Without this, in two years fediblockhole is five majors behind and the checkout digest points at something nobody has looked at.

packageRules.description: A major version is a reading task, not a merge task. fediblockhole decides what gets suspended, so a major of it wants reading more than most.

customManagers.description: FEDIBLOCKHOLE_VERSION in the workflow, which the pip install reads.
